**My pick is the Anker Prime Qi2 vent mount** (about $70–90). Two of the guides I read agree on it. I couldn't read the WIRED roundup because the page was too large to load, so it isn't part of this.

**Top picks**
- **Best overall: [Anker Prime MagSafe/Qi2 Car Mount](https://amzn.to/4vhoGXa).**
  - MountGuys uses it daily. They say it holds more securely than the Apple and Belkin vent mounts, and it has active cooling and charges at up to 25W.
  - It includes a 60W car adapter. The Gadgeteer lists it at $69.99 on sale, down from $89.99 ([buy link](https://pboost.me/p1SMdJ7da)).
  - The Gadgeteer warns the vent clip is narrow, so check your vent slat width first.
- **Best value with cooling: [LISEN Qi2.2 25W Car Mount with Fan](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FPFH7BN9?tag=r3media07-20), about $40.**
  - The Gadgeteer ranks it best overall. It includes a 95W adapter.
  - It's a suction mount, and the output drops to 15W if you turn the fan off.
  - I only found the one review of it.
- **Best budget with a fan: [ESR HaloLock Qi2 CryoBoost](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0CM3DCWQY?tag=r3media07-20).**
  - It's 15W with a fan and attaches to a vent or dashboard.
  - The car adapter isn't included, so add $10–15.
  - The Gadgeteer's price for it is inconsistent ($18.99 in one place, $35.99 in another), so check the current price.
- **Cheapest Qi2 option: [ESR HaloLock Qi2](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B08HNBHSQV?tag=r3media07-20), about $20–27.** It has no cooling and no adapter, so it's fine for a cool cabin and a short commute.

**Other situations**
- **Eye-level view, no charging:** [Andobil Vacuum Suction MagSafe Mount](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FWJYCJC6?tag=moun05-20). MountGuys tested it hands-on.
- **Trucks or rough roads:** [RAM Drill Down](https://amzn.to/3O2iQZj). It's the most stable option, but it needs drilling into your dash.
- **No usable vent or dash:** [EXELIQ Cup Holder Charger Mount](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0BJ688W1Q/?tag=moun05-20), which charges at 15W.
- **Included charger, dash mount:** [iOttie Velox Mini Qi2](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0D54Y5THX?tag=r3media07-20), about $42.

**Before you buy**
- **Look for the "Qi2" badge.** "MagSafe-compatible" alone may only charge at about 7.5W.
- **You need a proper car charger.** Built-in USB ports usually give 5–7.5W. A 15W mount needs an 18W+ adapter, and a 25W mount needs 30W+. The Anker needs 45W+ for full speed.
- **Heat matters.** The Gadgeteer says passive mounts can throttle to about 7W in hot, sunny cars. Choose a fan-cooled mount if that's your climate. That claim comes from the review, not my own testing.
- **Windshield mounts are restricted in some states**, including California, Minnesota and New Jersey. A vent or cup holder mount avoids the issue.
- **Use a MagSafe-compatible case,** or the magnetic hold will be much weaker.

Most of these links are affiliate links. If you tell me your phone model and whether you want a vent, dash or cup holder mount, I can narrow it to one.

Sources: [MountGuys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/), [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/)
